comment: The Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak's last boss's eggs (BNpcBase 572, all layout 3656521): 568 HP, level 24, each where the boss's 698 was aimed; 5 s after it lands it casts 730 (2.7 s, round itself: a hit and status 2089 for 15 s) and dies 2.1 s after that. The director has it do so (f1r1_re.lua); it does nothing else. For 364, 345 and 1014, which only poison, the recorded amount is the poison's tick (retail's ActionEffect gives it with the status). From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak (2026-10-30): one run with Duty Support (caa5e908, visit 0.15) and two Duty Finder runs (1fac2416 and 2528a32d, visits 0.15 and 0.14), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
